note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are a regional distributor. Our warehouse ships 2,400 orders a day, but only 1,800 leave the same day.

answers.common.decision: Which changes to make in the warehouse; the operations director decides.
answers.common.audience: The operations director and the warehouse manager.
answers.common.materials: A time study found an order takes 120 minutes from release to dispatch. Walking between aisles takes 48 minutes of that, and waiting at the packing bench takes 30 minutes.
answers.consulting.current-state: Pickers pick one order at a time and walk the whole warehouse for each. We added overtime last quarter, which helped a little.
answers.consulting.success: Ship 95% of orders the same day.
answers.consulting.constraints: No new building; budget for minor layout changes only.
